Mats Nilsson is a Swedish javelin thrower who competes in the men's javelin throw event. He was born on February 1, 1991, in Savsjö, Sweden.

Nilsson has a personal best throw of 87.32 meters, which he achieved in 2020. He has represented Sweden in various international competitions, including the European Athletics Championships and the World Athletics Championships.

Nilsson has won several medals in national and international competitions, including a silver medal at the 2019 European Team Championships.

Although Nilsson is a relatively young athlete, he has shown great potential and has the ability to become a top competitor in the javelin throw event in the future.
